issue.title: [Bug] os.fchmod is Unix-only, causing AttributeError on Windows

triage.root_cause: os.fchmod is a Unix-only function not available on Windows
triage.fix_strategy: Add hasattr(os, 'fchmod') check before calling os.fchmod

implementation.approach: Conditional check for os.fchmod availability with graceful fallback on Windows

risks: Windows behavior cannot be fully tested on Unix CI runners - relies on simulation via delattr
verification_criteria: TodoStorage.save() works on Windows without AttributeError
Existing tests pass on both Unix and Windows platforms
Temp file permissions remain restrictive (0o600) on Unix
